questions.source_note: Official film credits: Harry Potter film series.

questions.question_text: Who overhears part of the prophecy before reporting it to Voldemort?
questions.explanation: Snape overhears part of Trelawney's prophecy at the Hog's Head.
questions.source_note: Book: Order of the Phoenix and Half-Blood Prince; prophecy backstory.

questions.question_text: Where is the prophecy about Harry and Voldemort made?
questions.explanation: Trelawney makes the prophecy during an interview at the Hog's Head.
questions.source_note: Book: Order of the Phoenix; prophecy explanation.

questions.question_text: Who interviews Trelawney for the Divination post?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore interviews Trelawney when she makes the prophecy.
questions.source_note: Book: Order of the Phoenix; prophecy explanation.

questions.question_text: What object does Dumbledore use to show Harry Bob Ogden's memory?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore uses the Pensieve to show memories including Bob Ogden's.

questions.question_text: Who is Voldemort's maternal grandfather?
questions.explanation: Marvolo Gaunt is Merope's father and Voldemort's maternal grandfather.

questions.question_text: Who is Voldemort's Muggle father?
questions.explanation: Tom Riddle senior is Voldemort's father.
questions.source_note: Book: Half-Blood Prince; Riddle family memories.

questions.question_text: What family heirloom does Marvolo Gaunt show Bob Ogden as proof of descent?
questions.explanation: Marvolo displays the ring as a Gaunt heirloom.

questions.question_text: Who is blamed and imprisoned for the Riddle murders before dying in Azkaban?
questions.explanation: Morfin is framed by Tom Riddle and dies in Azkaban.

questions.question_text: Who plays young Tom Riddle in Chamber of Secrets?
questions.explanation: Christian Coulson plays teenage Tom Riddle in Chamber of Secrets.
questions.source_note: Official film credits: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets.

questions.question_text: Who plays young Tom Riddle in Half-Blood Prince?
questions.explanation: Frank Dillane plays teenage Tom Riddle in Half-Blood Prince.
questions.source_note: Official film credits: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince.

questions.question_text: Who defeats Grindelwald and wins the Elder Wand in 1945?
questions.explanation: Dumbledore defeats Grindelwald and becomes master of the Elder Wand.

questions.question_text: Who steals the Elder Wand from Gregorovitch before Dumbledore wins it?
questions.explanation: Grindelwald steals the Elder Wand from Gregorovitch.

questions.question_text: Where is Grindelwald imprisoned when Voldemort visits him?
questions.explanation: Grindelwald is imprisoned in Nurmengard.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; Voldemort seeks the Elder Wand.

questions.question_text: Why does Voldemort kill Snape near the end of Deathly Hallows?
questions.answer_b: He thinks Snape commands the Elder Wand
questions.explanation: Voldemort wrongly believes killing Snape will make him master of the Elder Wand.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; Shrieking Shack scene.

questions.question_text: Who actually masters the Elder Wand after Draco disarms Dumbledore and Harry later overpowers Draco?
questions.explanation: Harry becomes master after taking Draco's wand at Malfoy Manor.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; final confrontation explanation.

questions.question_text: Who lies to Voldemort about Harry being dead in the forest?
questions.explanation: Narcissa says Harry is dead after confirming Draco is alive.

questions.question_text: What does Harry use to view Snape's memories after Snape dies?
questions.explanation: Harry takes Snape's memories to the Pensieve.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; The Prince's Tale.

questions.question_text: Who sent the doe Patronus that led Harry to Gryffindor's sword?
questions.explanation: Snape sends the doe Patronus to guide Harry.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; The Prince's Tale.

questions.question_text: Who plays Bathilda Bagshot in Deathly Hallows Part 1?
questions.explanation: Hazel Douglas plays Bathilda Bagshot.
questions.source_note: Official film credits: Deathly Hallows Part 1.

questions.question_text: Who composed the music for the first three Harry Potter films?
questions.explanation: John Williams composed the scores for the first three films.
questions.source_note: Official film credits: first three Harry Potter films.

questions.question_text: What phrase is engraved on Ariana Dumbledore's grave?
questions.answer_a: Where your treasure is, there will your heart be also
questions.answer_b: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death
questions.answer_d: Neither can live while the other survives
questions.explanation: Ariana's grave bears the treasure and heart inscription.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; Godric's Hollow graveyard.

questions.question_text: What phrase is engraved on the Potters' grave?
questions.answer_a: Where your treasure is, there will your heart be also
questions.answer_c: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death
questions.explanation: The Potters' grave bears the inscription about the last enemy.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; Godric's Hollow graveyard.

questions.question_text: What phrase is written above the entrance to Nurmengard prison?
questions.explanation: For the Greater Good is written above the entrance to Nurmengard prison.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; Voldemort visits Grindelwald at Nurmengard.

questions.question_text: Who wrote the scandalous biography The Life and Lies of Albus Dumbledore?
questions.explanation: Rita Skeeter writes The Life and Lies of Albus Dumbledore.

questions.question_text: What does Bathilda Bagshot's body contain when Harry visits Godric's Hollow?
questions.explanation: Nagini is hidden inside Bathilda's corpse.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; Godric's Hollow attack.

questions.question_text: Who saves Harry from drowning when he dives for Gryffindor's sword?
questions.explanation: Ron rescues Harry from the pool after the locket drags him down.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; Silver Doe chapter.

questions.question_text: What does the locket show Ron before he destroys it?
questions.answer_d: Visions of Harry and Hermione mocking him
questions.explanation: The locket torments Ron with images of Harry and Hermione.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; Silver Doe chapter.

questions.question_text: Who casts the Protego Horribilis protection over Hogwarts before the battle?
questions.explanation: Flitwick casts protective enchantments including Protego Horribilis.
questions.source_note: Book: Deathly Hallows; Battle of Hogwarts preparations.

questions.question_text: Who plays Charity Burbage in Deathly Hallows Part 1?
questions.explanation: Carolyn Pickles plays Charity Burbage.
questions.source_note: Official film credits: Deathly Hallows Part 1.

questions.question_text: Who composed the score for Deathly Hallows Part 2?
questions.explanation: Alexandre Desplat composed Deathly Hallows Part 2.
questions.source_note: Official film credits: Deathly Hallows Part 2.
